project.title: Comparative genomics of Delftia and the genetic basis of beta-carboline production
project.description: Whole-genome sequencing of Delftia tsuruhatensis ATCC BAA-554 and Delftia acidovorans ATCC 13751 and ATCC 15668, generated to support a 40-genome comparative analysis of candidate beta-carboline (harmane) biosynthetic loci across the genus.

samples: Delftia tsuruhatensis ATCC BAA-554 (type strain T7)
activated sludge from a domestic wastewater treatment plant
